<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>puneeth@zeo</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0b0d12;
    --panel:#11141b;
    --border:#242938;
    --text:#c9d1d9;
    --dim:#5b6472;
    --accent:#7dd3fc;   /* label cyan, like neofetch headers */
    --accent2:#a78bfa;  /* soft violet for section dividers */
    --white:#f5f7fa;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{
    margin:0; padding:0; height:100%;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 15% 10%, #151a24 0%, transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono','Fira Code',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
    color:var(--text);
  }
  .card{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:48px;
    background:var(--panel);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:16px;
    padding:40px 56px;
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
    max-width:1000px;
  }
  .portrait-wrap{
    position:relative;
    width:260px;
    height:260px;
    flex:0 0 auto;
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;
    justify-content:center;
  }
  .portrait-glow{
    position:absolute;
    inset:-30px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%, rgba(125,211,252,.18), transparent 65%);
    filter:blur(6px);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .portrait-wrap img{
    position:relative;
    max-width:100%;
    max-height:100%;
    object-fit:contain;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 0 18px rgba(255,255,255,.15));
  }
  .info{ font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; }
  .whoami{
    color:var(--white);
    font-size:17px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.2px;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .whoami .at{ color:var(--accent2); }
  .rule{
    border:none;
    height:1px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border), transparent);
    margin:10px 0 14px;
  }
  .section-label{
    color:var(--accent2);
    margin:16px 0 6px;
    letter-spacing:.5px;
  }
  .row{ white-space:pre; }
  .k{ color:var(--accent); }
  .dots{ color:var(--dim); }
  .v{ color:var(--text); }

  .swatches{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:18px; }
  .swatches span{ width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:4px; display:inline-block; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="card">

  <div class="portrait-wrap">
    <div class="portrait-glow"></div>
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Puneeth">
  </div>

  <div class="info">
    <div class="whoami">puneeth<span class="at">@</span>zeo</div>
    <hr class="rule">

    <div class="row"><span class="k">Role      </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Founder, Zeo AI</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Education </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">B.Tech AI/ML, Srinivas Institute of Technology</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Title     </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Google Gemini Student Ambassador</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Focus     </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Offline-first, low-resource AI</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Research  </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Co-author, dark matter &amp; dark energy paper</span></div>

    <div class="section-label">- Stack -----------------------</div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Languages </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Python, JavaScript, C++</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">Runtime   </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">Quantized local inference, SQLite</span></div>

    <div class="section-label">- Contact ---------------------</div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">GitHub    </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">github.com/yourhandle</span></div>
    <div class="row"><span class="k">LinkedIn  </span><span class="dots">: </span><span class="v">linkedin.com/in/yourhandle</span></div>

    <div class="swatches">
      <span style="background:#7dd3fc"></span>
      <span style="background:#a78bfa"></span>
      <span style="background:#f5f7fa"></span>
      <span style="background:#5b6472"></span>
      <span style="background:#11141b;border:1px solid #242938"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

</body>
</html>
